about: Named Commons flows for the app-check skill (harness-autonomy-plan B6). Each step is one /shot run (see .claude/skills/shot). Mobile Chromium only: WebKit stays with the test suites. Only screens /shot can reach: Cats and Courts aren't switched on there.

hub.about: Commons home, signed out and signed in

steps.name: signed out
steps.expect: The Commons welcome: the logo, the tagline and section cards (Events, Bookings, Pets, The Community), with no greeting to a home

steps.name: member
steps.expect: Jubail Commons, 'Welcome, Villa 12', the Events card with See Events, Bookings marked coming soon

events.about: Events list, the live test event and the archived Halloween event

steps.name: list
steps.expect: Events: National Day Gathering with a Sign Up button, and Halloween 2026 under Past

steps.name: live event
steps.expect: National Day Gathering: Map / List / Sign Up tabs, a map with one numbered pin, Full Screen and Find Me

steps.name: archived event
steps.expect: Halloween 2026, The Numbers: 124 homes, 3 villages, participation by village as bars

home.about: My Home, with and without a home set

steps.name: member
steps.expect: My Home: Villa 12, Ain Al Maha, pinned on the map, Move Pin and Fix House Details

steps.name: no home
steps.expect: Your Home, step 2 of 3: village choices, home type and house number, a Continue button

steps.name: member
steps.expect: Signed in as a@example.com, Continue to Commons and Sign Out buttons

admin.about: Organizer Tools, and the new-event form from the market template

steps.name: organizer
steps.expect: Organizer Tools unlocked for Events: Events / Community / Announcement tabs, New Event, the Test Event card with its actions

steps.name: community admin
steps.expect: Organizer Tools unlocked as Community admin: more tabs (Events, Bookings, Pets, Community…), the Test Event card with Admins

steps.name: new event (market)
steps.expect: New Event form: Title (English) required, Title (Arabic), Short name for links, the description toolbar

pets.about: Pets list, a missing pet and your own pet

steps.name: list
steps.expect: Pets: Missing Now with Ginger and Luna (red Missing chips), then the filter chips

steps.name: missing pet (Luna)
steps.expect: Luna: the red 'missing since' box with last seen, About / Sightings / Map tabs, Report seeing Luna

steps.name: my pet (Mochi)
steps.expect: Mochi, marked Yours: lives at Home 12, Your Pet box with Report as missing and Edit details
